description: Free estimate for UK sole traders. Checks annual turnover against the VAT registration threshold (flags "near" within 10%), explains the rolling 12-month and 30-day forward-look rules, and says whether and from when Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies. Give the optional qualifying income for each tax year for a definite answer; with only turnover it gives an estimate.

annual_turnover_gbp.description: Annual self-employment turnover in pounds, before expenses.

is_vat_registered.description: Whether the business is already VAT registered.

property_income_gbp.description: Annual gross property income in pounds, if any.

qualifying_income_2024_25_gbp.description: Qualifying income (gross self-employment turnover plus gross property income, before expenses) shown on the 2024 to 2025 Self Assessment return. Give it for a definite Making Tax Digital answer.

qualifying_income_2025_26_gbp.description: Qualifying income (gross self-employment turnover plus gross property income, before expenses) shown on the 2025 to 2026 Self Assessment return. Give it for a definite Making Tax Digital answer.

qualifying_income_2026_27_gbp.description: Qualifying income (gross self-employment turnover plus gross property income, before expenses) shown on the 2026 to 2027 Self Assessment return. Give it for a definite Making Tax Digital answer.
